column3: NKJV includes “and the Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV lacks “and growing,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “qualified us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “qualified you.”
NKJV includes “through His blood,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “in Christ Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in Christ.”
